sources.title: Nauru Department of Justice and Border Control: Passport Division
sources.publisher: Department of Justice and Border Control, Republic of Nauru
sources.officialityEvidence: Nauru's Passport Division applies the Passports Act 2011, says every Nauruan citizen is entitled to an ordinary Nauruan passport, and separately limits diplomatic, official and refugee-related documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A Nauruan citizen is entitled to an ordinary Nauruan passport.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries and provides electronic delivery of the visa certificate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The live institutional Government page identifies itself as the Government of Equatorial Guinea and directly confirms that the equatorialguinea-evisa.com portal is operational for visitors to obtain visas online without an in-person visit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: eligibility and electronic delivery
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its FAQ supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: regular-passport application process
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its current process requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Nauruan ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use a Nauruan ordinary passport. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days, with the stated passport-validity and supporting-document requirements.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current all-country document does not identify a Nauruan ordinary-passport exception; this classification is medium confidence. Work, residence, diplomatic, official, refugee, emergency, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Nauruan ordinary passport and required tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and required documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Nauruan ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's institutional Government page authenticates its online visa service; the current service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Apply using the Nauruan ordinary passport that will be used for travel; the official portal excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload the required visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application with the Nauruan ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Pay online and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record and meet entry-point and final-admission conditions.
